Peter Byrne’s Fancy, X:8

Based on Finbar Furey’s rendition on Traditional Irish Pipe Music (1969) which may have been the first known recording. Not every variation is included and some triplets have been omitted. On this tune, Finbar plays a flat set in C. The first sounding note is routine for pitch and a last chance to tune drones before launching into a set. Even Finbar’s drones have drifted by the end of the tune.

↳ Posted by Shawn Cassady on April 25th, 2026.

The original link is thesession.org/tunes/2919
